name: Camp Black Rock
operator_name: Upper Providence Township Parks and Recreation
description_short: Six week township day camp run by Upper Providence Township Parks and Recreation for ages 5 to 12, with field trips included. Camp runs 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. and is capped at 65 campers a week.
notes: Prices are non-resident rates: $1,400 for all six weeks or $325 for one week. Upper Providence residents pay $1,300 or $275, and the first 20 residents on a one day early bird date (January 30 in 2026) get a lower price. No camp June 29 to July 3. Price includes all field trips, a daily afternoon snack, Kona Ice on Mondays, pizza lunch on Fridays and one camp t-shirt; campers bring lunch the other days. The township also runs one week vendor specialty camps (Bricks 4 Kidz, Mad Science, theater, preschool and others), not listed here.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Camp Black Rock 2026: June 15 to July 31, no camp June 29 to July 3, 8 a.m. to 4 p.m., ages 5 to 12, 65 campers a week. Non-resident $1,400 (6 weeks) and $325 (1 week); resident $1,300 and $275. The page does not say where camp meets; city is the Parks and Recreation office's (499 Hopwood Rd., Collegeville).
